phase3_findings.description: A value-taking flag with no operand makes the arg loop spin forever: `shift 2` with one positional left fails and shifts nothing under `set -uo pipefail` (no -e), so the loop re-matches the same flag. No token, no breadcrumb, no exit.

An absent/null baseRefName emitted as "" in the middle field collapses under `read`, shifting the yes/no token into PR_BASE — the helper then reports closes-issue failed when it held, and names the base as literally 'yes'.

The new helper was never registered in cloud_writer_contract.py REQUIRED_HELPER_HEADS["implement"], so grant-sync, helper-boundary and the manifest byte-pin all failed open on exactly the helper this change adds.
The three arm-order assertions were tautological — each operand was already asserted equal to a distinct literal, so distinctness followed by construction and the rows had zero detection power.

The two multi-PR assert_eq descriptions were swapped: the 'selected by createdAt, not array position' label was attached to the newest-first control row, which cannot fail under the .[0] regression it names.
The CREATE arm's 'check that the create itself succeeded' policy named an operand no step produced — the fence ended in a bare unguarded `gh pr create`.
Six of eight REFUSED causes were undriven (unrecognized arg, non-numeric issue, gh empty stdout, unparseable JSON, and both value-less-flag shapes), and no fixture exercised an absent JSON field.
resolve-gh.sh was sourced without the outcome guard its resolve-jq.sh sibling three lines below carries; a partial deployment surfaced as a breadcrumb blaming GitHub.
jq's stderr was discarded on the one path whose breadcrumb claims to explain a parse failure.
The ${FAILED:+$FAILED,} comment credited the join with an ordering guarantee that the statement order actually provides.
A self-referential count ('six more chains') in a run.sh comment — the PR-#553 rot class.
docs/implement-skill.md:512 and docs/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md:277 still describe the §3.1 resolution as inline shell and omit the WARN:<checks> validation arm. Diff-untouched, so a doc-sync item.
The --base-omitted row couples the suite to this repo's own .devflow/config.json base_branch value.
